name: Kamiya Yun
source:
"Now, Fuu-chan. Let’s intertwine just like the strings of destiny?"
"Fu fu, it’s okay I’ll lead, my princess."

Position: Soldier
Weapon: Bow gun

He has a bright character and is kind to anyone, he takes great interest in the protagonist and flirts with her.
Because he is always flirty and trying to make a move on the protagonist he is sometimes referred to as “pervert” by the team.
When a [Dealer] is the target in a mission he becomes unsettled and loses his attitude.

[Edited from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90317810847/binary-star-main-characters]Cannonette[/url]]
